topic: Tenses – going to-future: going to-future – Statements
title: going to-future: Plans and Predictions

explanation.tr:
going to-future şu durumlarda kullanılır:
• Önceden yapılmış planlar ve niyetler: I'm going to visit my grandma this weekend.
• Şu anki işaretlere dayanan tahminler: Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
• Yapı: am/is/are + going to + yalın fiil
  I am going to ..., He/She/It is going to ..., You/We/They are going to ...
• will ile fark: will = anlık karar; going to = önceden karar.
  "We're out of milk." – "I'll buy some." (anlık) / I'm going to buy milk after work. (plan)
explanation.tk:
going to-future şu ýagdaýlarda ulanylýar:
• Öňünden edilen meýilnamalar we niýetler: I'm going to visit my grandma this weekend.
• Häzirki alamatlara esaslanan çaklamalar: Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
• Gurluşy: am/is/are + going to + esasy işlik
  I am going to ..., He/She/It is going to ..., You/We/They are going to ...
• will bilen tapawudy: will = şol pursatdaky karar; going to = öňünden karar.
  "We're out of milk." – "I'll buy some." (pursatda) / I'm going to buy milk after work. (meýilnama)
explanation.ru:
going to-future используется для:
• Заранее принятых планов и намерений: I'm going to visit my grandma this weekend.
• Прогнозов на основе того, что видно сейчас: Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
• Схема: am/is/are + going to + глагол
  I am going to ..., He/She/It is going to ..., You/We/They are going to ...
• Разница с will: will = решение в момент речи; going to = решение принято заранее.
  "We're out of milk." – "I'll buy some." (спонтанно) / I'm going to buy milk after work. (план)

topic: Tenses – going to-future: Negations in the going to-future
title: going to-future: Negative Sentences

explanation.tr:
going to-future olumsuz:
• am not / isn't / aren't + going to + yalın fiil
  I'm not going to tell him. She isn't going to come. They aren't going to wait.
• Kısaltmalar: I'm not, he isn't / he's not, we aren't / we're not.
• 'I amn't' diye bir kısaltma yoktur → I'm not.
• Anlam: plan yok / olmayacağı belli: It isn't going to be easy.
explanation.tk:
going to-future ýokluk:
• am not / isn't / aren't + going to + esasy işlik
  I'm not going to tell him. She isn't going to come. They aren't going to wait.
• Gysgaltmalar: I'm not, he isn't / he's not, we aren't / we're not.
• 'I amn't' diýen gysgaltma ýok → I'm not.
• Manysy: meýilnama ýok / bolmajagy belli: It isn't going to be easy.
explanation.ru:
Отрицание в going to-future:
• am not / isn't / aren't + going to + глагол
  I'm not going to tell him. She isn't going to come. They aren't going to wait.
• Сокращения: I'm not, he isn't / he's not, we aren't / we're not.
• Формы 'I amn't' нет → I'm not.
• Смысл: плана нет / ясно, что не случится: It isn't going to be easy.

topic: Tenses – going to-future: Questions and short answers in the going to-future
title: going to-future: Questions and Short Answers

explanation.tr:
going to-future soru: Am/Is/Are + özne + going to + yalın fiil?
• Are you going to come? Is she going to stay?
• Kısa cevaplar:
  Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
  Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
  Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
• Kısa olumlu cevapta kısaltma olmaz: Yes, I am. (✓) – Yes, I'm. (✗)
explanation.tk:
going to-future sorag: Am/Is/Are + eýe + going to + esasy işlik?
• Are you going to come? Is she going to stay?
• Gysga jogaplar:
  Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
  Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
  Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
• Gysga tassyklaýjy jogapda gysgaltma bolmaýar: Yes, I am. (✓) – Yes, I'm. (✗)
explanation.ru:
Вопрос в going to-future: Am/Is/Are + подлежащее + going to + глагол?
• Are you going to come? Is she going to stay?
• Краткие ответы:
  Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
  Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
  Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
• В кратком утвердительном ответе без сокращения: Yes, I am. (✓) – Yes, I'm. (✗)

topic: Tenses – going to-future: Questions in the going to-future
title: going to-future: Wh-Questions

explanation.tr:
Soru kelimeli going to soruları:
• Soru kelimesi + am/is/are + özne + going to + yalın fiil?
  What are you going to do? Where is she going to live? When are they going to arrive?
• Özne sorusu: Who is going to drive? What is going to happen?
• How long are you going to stay? How much is it going to cost?
explanation.tk:
Sorag sözli going to soraglary:
• Sorag sözi + am/is/are + eýe + going to + esasy işlik?
  What are you going to do? Where is she going to live? When are they going to arrive?
• Eýe soragy: Who is going to drive? What is going to happen?
• How long are you going to stay? How much is it going to cost?
explanation.ru:
Специальные вопросы с going to:
• Вопросительное слово + am/is/are + подлежащее + going to + глагол?
  What are you going to do? Where is she going to live? When are they going to arrive?
• Вопрос к подлежащему: Who is going to drive? What is going to happen?
• How long are you going to stay? How much is it going to cost?

topic: Tenses – going to-future: Sentences and questions in the going to-future
title: going to-future: Mixed Practice

explanation.tr:
going to-future'ın tüm biçimlerini birlikte çalış:
• Olumlu: I'm going to start yoga.
• Olumsuz: I'm not going to start yoga.
• Soru: Are you going to start yoga?
• Wh-soru: When are you going to start yoga?
• Kısa cevap: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
am/is/are özneye göre değişir; going to + yalın fiil sabittir.
explanation.tk:
going to-future-iň ähli görnüşlerini bilelikde türgenleş:
• Tassyklaýjy: I'm going to start yoga.
• Ýokluk: I'm not going to start yoga.
• Sorag: Are you going to start yoga?
• Wh-sorag: When are you going to start yoga?
• Gysga jogap: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
am/is/are eýä görä üýtgeýär; going to + esasy işlik üýtgemeýär.
explanation.ru:
Тренируй все формы going to-future вместе:
• Утверждение: I'm going to start yoga.
• Отрицание: I'm not going to start yoga.
• Вопрос: Are you going to start yoga?
• Специальный вопрос: When are you going to start yoga?
• Краткий ответ: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
am/is/are зависит от подлежащего; going to + глагол не меняется.
